summary:
Iter 27 — Public gallery share links, Friends (invite/accept/DM), memory pin, mixed-group AI silence, two-tier compact summary, gallery search & preview drawer. Backend 14/14 PASS (test_iter27.py). Frontend PASS (Playwright).

Backend: POST /api/shares {kind:document, hours:5} → 400; hours:24 → code; GET /api/public/share/{code} (no auth) → kind/title/content; /export/pdf → 200 + Content-Disposition:attachment; DELETE /api/shares/{code} → 200 then public GET → 404. Image share with path → /file returns 200 image/*. POST /api/friends/invite {email:'budi@aivora.ai'} from demo → 400 'Sudah berteman'. GET /api/friends → friends[] contains budi@aivora.ai. POST /api/friends/{budiId}/chat twice → same conversation id. GET /api/conversations for demo lists dm with title 'Budi'; for budi lists dm with title 'Demo'. POST /api/friends/invite {email:'qa-teman-<ts>@example.com'} → {status:'emailed'} and email appears in GET /api/friends.email_invites[]. POST /api/memory + PUT /api/memory/{id} {pinned:true} → pinned=true. SSE on mixed group (90435108): budi 'oke siap' → no persona_name event (no AI); budi 'Rio, tolong sebutkan 2 manfaat menabung' → event with persona_name=='Rio'. POST /api/conversations/{MIXED_GROUP}/compact → 200 {summary, archived, archive_id}; GET /api/archives/{archive_id}.summary set; GET /api/conversations/{cid}/messages .conversation.memory_summary len <= 1500. /api/gallery?q=Bandung → items filtered; /api/tasks loads; login demo+budi both 200.

Frontend: /gallery → gallery-search typing 'Bandung' → 3 cards; clearing → 24 cards (debounced). Clicking gallery-item-document opens GalleryPreview drawer with preview-title at viewport y=17.5 (top-anchored), preview-dl-docx, preview-dl-pdf, preview-share, preview-body, preview-close all present. preview-share → share-modal; share-hours-168 → share-create → share-link renders https://.../s/<code>; share-copy clicked OK (no error toast). Opening /s/<code> in a NEW browser context (no login) → share-title, share-body, share-dl-docx all render. share-revoke-<code> clicked in modal → re-opening /s/<code> shows share-error (1). /friends page: friend-invite-form, friend-invite-email, friend-invite-submit, friend-search, friend-card-<budiId>, friend-chat (navigates to /chat/<dmId>), friend-call, friend-remove, friend-pending all present; inviting unregistered 'qa-ui-<ts>@example.com' adds entry to friend-pending section with text 'email ajakan terkirim, belum mendaftar'. /chat left panel: ASISTEN section (asst-Rio/Nova/Nadia, ordered by activity Rio 19:17 > Nova 1 Okt > Nadia), TEMAN section with friend-<budiId> labeled 'Budi' + unread dot, GRUP section with many conv-<id>. Clicking friend row navigates to /chat/5e6c2fc5...; header subtitle 'Teman · tambahkan asisten dengan tombol +'; sending 'Halo Budi, tes pesan' renders the user bubble (visible in screenshot) with no error toast and no AI reply. new-group-btn modal shows TEMAN section (Budi) + ASISTEN section (Rio, Nova); pick-friend-<budiId> present. /personas/<Rio>/Memori: mem-input + mem-add create a memory; clicking mem-pin-<new id> re-orders list — the testid at position [0] changed from the previously pinned memory id to the newly pinned id (visual star fill confirmed via SVG inner HTML containing 'fill').
critical_code_review_comments: shares.py uses secrets.token_urlsafe(9) → ~12 chars; collision probability low but a unique index on {code} would harden it. Currently only _id index; add db.shares.create_index('code', unique=True) during startup.

shares.py _live() compares expires_at as ISO strings (`< now_iso()`). Works because ISO 8601 with same offset is lexicographically ordered, but ONLY when every doc stores the same timezone format. Documents are created with datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() so '+00:00' is uniform — ok. Still, prefer datetime comparison for robustness.
shares.create_share stores and returns `clean(doc)` which includes user_id — fine for owner, but reconsider if /shares list is ever exposed publicly.

friends.py invite() upserts the friend row with $set=doc even when existing is 'rejected'/'blocked' etc — currently only {accepted,pending} are checked; the upsert on rejected would reactivate a rejected request without going through accept flow. Minor edge case.
friends.py friend_chat builds `titles` only for pair members present in `people` dict; if a user record is missing it silently omits the title for that side. Minor.

chat.py send_message: humans_chat = len(participants)>1 and type!=meeting. For a 'dm' type conv with only 2 humans and no personas, this correctly skips responders. For a 'group' type with assistants + friends, humans_chat is true (participants>1) → good. For a normal private persona chat (participants=[user] single), humans_chat is false → good.

chat.py _addressed_to_ai AI_ADDRESS_RE triggers on trailing '?' — a friend asking another human 'kamu di mana?' would be mis-routed to assistants. Consider also checking for presence of @mention OR explicit assistant name before falling back to the question-mark heuristic.

Gallery.jsx uses the SAME data-testid 'gallery-item-document' and 'gallery-item-image' on every card instead of unique IDs like 'gallery-item-document-<task_id>'. This complicates deterministic testing when selecting a specific card. Share buttons also share testid 'gallery-share' across cards. Low-priority but notable for test authors.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created: 1 revoked document share (cleaned via DELETE); 1 live image share (24h) + 1 live document share from frontend run (7d, revoked at end of UI test); 1 memory item on Rio (cleaned via DELETE); 1 'emailed' friend-invite for qa-teman-<ts>@example.com (status pending in friend_email_invites). Frontend created 1 pending friend-email-invite qa-ui-<ts>@example.com (not cleaned — add to Teman > Menunggu). test_compact_two_tier_summary ran compact on MIXED_GROUP (90435108-…), which archived its live messages, created a new chat_archives entry, and set the conv's memory_summary (<=1500 chars). Memory pin test added one memory to Rio via API and deleted it; UI pin test added one memory (QA pin UI <ts>) that remains pinned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: shares.HOURS allowlist = {1,24,168,720}. GET /api/public/share/{code} returns {kind,name,title,content,...} for documents; /file for binary (path); /export/{docx|pdf|xlsx} for documents. share codes = secrets.token_urlsafe(9). Friends: GET /api/friends → {friends[], incoming[], outgoing[], email_invites[{email,created_at}]}. POST /api/friends/invite with already-friend returns 400 'Sudah berteman'; unregistered → {status:'emailed'}. POST /api/friends/{uid}/chat requires existing accepted friendship (403 otherwise); conv.type='dm', pair=sorted[u,other], titles={u:other_name, other:u_name}. In chat.send_message, humans_chat path: assistants reply only if @mentioned OR _addressed_to_ai regex matches (question mark, 'tolong', 'bisakah', assistant name, etc). bill_user falls back to conv.user_id (group owner) when responders exist and sender != owner. compact spends credits via llm_text calls (detailed + core merge). Gallery.jsx uses non-unique testids for cards and share buttons — select by index/first.
